caption: The drawing depicts a single tool positioned diagonally across the paper, with the handle in the upper right region and the working end at the bottom left. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black on a light beige background, with no other objects present. The tool consists of a long, straight handle that tapers slightly and ends in a loop at the very top. The handle is connected to a horizontal bar perpendicular to its length, forming a T-shape. Attached to this horizontal bar are six evenly spaced, U-shaped prongs or tines that extend downward, each with two narrow points, resembling a rake or cultivating tool. The drawing is detailed, showing the mechanical connection between the handle and the horizontal bar, and the background is plain with minimal markings aside from a faint signature or text in the bottom right corner.
title: Wrought Iron Toaster
